text: {"refute":true,"confidence":1,"reason":"The finding claims a discrepancy between the page and the database regarding GMGT 671's topic. The page clearly states \"Fall 2022 Topic: GMGT 671 01 Topic: Performance Management\". The database description provided, \"This innovative leadership course explores trauma-informed leadership...\", is for a different course or a different offering of GMGT 671. The page itself provides a detailed description for the \"Performance Management\" topic immediately following the topic heading. The database description is not for the Fall 2022 offering of GMGT 671 as presented on the page. Therefore, the reported claim is a false positive because it incorrectly assumes the database description applies to the specific topic listed on the page for Fall 2022, when the page itself provides the correct description for that topic."}
